description: This is a Perl test source file (test script) for the lighttpd web server. It performs extensive testing of HTTP request handling, including header parsing, request methods, status codes, content negotiation, authentication, CGI scripting, response headers, range requests, and server behavior under various conditions.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A test helper class for starting, stopping, and interacting with the lighttpd server during tests.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request, returns status code, and populates response headers for verification.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd server process with the current configuration.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if the server has a specific feature enabled, like zlib support.
